messages:
Carmen: Quick sync — finalizing micro-segmentation and gating rules for the early-access newsletter drip. Need rules + suppression by EOD Thu. Goal: reduce churn, surface Dedicated trial candidates, and route high-intent leads to SDRs.
Matt: @Carmen are we still using the signup-week correlation for intent? can we auto-tag `prod-trial` from usage signal?
Sophia: Ran cohort analysis this morning — two clear high-value segments: `heavy_query` (>=10 req/day) and `evalers` (ran eval harness). Propose tags: heavy_query, eval_trial; include region: NA/EU. Exclude anyone who got promo in last 30d.
Julia: Subject line tests: A) "You’re in — Early access and performance tips" B) "Unlock dedicated capacity: early access for power users" — also want distinct preheaders. Thoughts? :eyes: 
Aaron: Ops constraints: cap sends to 5k/hour to avoid ESP throttles. Set suppression window 48h after any send to same user. Webhook to SDR only when intent_score >= 0.8.
Carmen: :thumbsup: agree. Also add a no-response path: 3-email nurture over 9 days, then suppress for 60d.
Matt: We should append UTM params for attribution: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=ea_launch&utm_segment={segment}`
Sophia: I'll push the segment definitions into Audience Tool and create a preview. Preview: https://app.redwood.com/audiences/ea_launch_preview (internal)
Julia: For segmentation mapping: use Subject A for heavy_query, Subject B for evalers. Preheaders: A -> "Performance tips inside" ; B -> "Scale with Dedicated pools".
Carmen: Sample send config (draft):
```json
{
  "campaign_id": "ea_launch_v3",
  "segments": ["heavy_query", "eval_trial"],
  "cadence": {"email_count": 3, "interval_days": [0, 3, 9]},
  "send_rate_limit": 5000,
  "suppression_window_days": 48,
  "sdr_webhook": {"url": "https://hooks.redwood.com/sdr", "min_intent": 0.8},
  "utm_template": "utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=ea_launch&utm_segment={segment}",
  "personalization_tokens": ["first_name","company"],
  "fallback_plain_text": true
}
```
email-bot: Campaign preview ready — campaign_id=ea_launch_v3, preview_url=https://app.redwood.com/campaigns/ea_launch_v3/preview
Aaron: QA checklist before send: confirm links + UTM, verify DKIM/SPF with infra, seedlist open/click checks, test personalization tokens, validate fallback/plain-text, confirm deliverability window w/ops.
Carmen: Design — can you produce a plain-text fallback and one compact HTML variant by EOD? Also need a short hero GIF <200KB for the top of the email.
Design: On it — will drop plain-text + compact HTML in the design drive by 3pm.
Matt: Once preview passes, let's A/B 20% of heavy_query segment first, then roll remaining 80% after 24h performance check.
Sophia: I'll tag the users for SDR routing and set up a pre-send report with top 50 high-intent users.
Carmen: Perfect. I'll collate and send the final launch checklist tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone :rocket:
